verdict.rationale: CDP exposes an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that surfaces every API endpoint as a tool, and Coinbase Wallet MCP lets an AI assistant check balances, send funds, swap tokens, and pay with x402 — enabling natural-language operation via an MCP-compatible AI client. However, this requires a separate AI client/agent host to interpret NL commands; there's no evidence of a built-in chat/NL interface within CDP itself, no independent hands-on validation of the MCP tool coverage, and no examples of complex NL command sequences being executed reliably. missing for 10: first-party or independent demonstration of end-to-end natural-language command execution, evidence of NL interface beyond MCP tool exposure, and confirmation of reliability/robustness of the MCP tool-calling across the full API surface.
